reviews.text: Had my first haircut with Hal and it turned out  phenomenal! I messed up and booked the wrong service, but Hal was incredibly accommodating. Made extra time to clean up my beard too!! He has great attention to detail and I will certainly be going back to him for my haircut needs. Grooming Lounge is an awesome spot, highly recommend!

Hands down the best place to get a haircut in Chicago. Corey always gives me great haircuts and it's always a pleasure to walk in and have some great chats about everything and anything during the cut. Can't recommend this place enough!

Corey and Hal are the best. Wouldn’t go anywhere else. I have been coming here for 7 years and have nothing but good things to say. Figured it was time to write a review to let other people in on the hidden gem these two are.

Grooming Lounge Chicago is a class act! It is a space for the refined gentlemen of Chicago to get first class haircuts and other barber needs. One appreciates the atmosphere of elegance and culture and professionalism Grooming Lounge Chicago provides.  My barber, Corey, was a very good barber. Corey's dedication to his craft is impressive as is his witty and comical banter. I always felt classy and posh whenever I entered into or left Grooming Lounge Chicago. The complementary cologne selection in the bathroom was always a great, great treat!
Corey and Hal are an awesome duo! Highly recommend this place
Got my haircut here for the first time. Showed up on time, got seated on time, and came out with a fantastic haircut from Hal as well as a good conversation. Will be back.
Skilled and Staff is easy to interact with
Been in Chicago 10 months and struggled to find a barber I like. Happy to say I now have. I don’t even live in wicker park but I’ll make the trip because it’s worth it.
Hal did an awesome job. Highly recommend
This place is great. Highly recommend Hal
Great hair cuts. These guys make you look stylish, and they've got a good variety of services.
